questions.context:
A paragraph about a local farmer in Colombia.

options.feedback: Incorrect. "Grow" needs an 's' and "hurry" has a spelling error.
Correct! Grows (+s), Fixes (+es for -x), and Hurries (-y to -ies for consonant + y).
Incorrect. "Fix" ends in 'x', so it needs 'es'.
Incorrect. "Hurry" ends in consonant + y, so it must change to "hurries".

questions.explanation: The student evaluates multiple verb types and their specific third-person spelling rules to complete a coherent text.
